revision: MAHPLAZA slice v3 — the commit that contains this file (git log -1 -- validation/mahworld/mahplaza-v3/gates.json); capture.json.revision names the working tree the captures came from
soak: soak.json: 15.5 real minutes (idle 5 / navigation 5 / re-entry 5), 0 page errors; JS heap bucketed flat at 13.6 MB in every sample; renderer geometries 398 → 418 as views first come into frame, identical plateau in both sessions (no growth); textures 12 and programs 29 constant. Ran concurrently with the proof capture, so its frame times are inflated.

gates.name: Reference match — composition, three destinations, plaza / sidewalk / road, restrained skyline
gates.note: v3-establishing-*, v3-in-world-*: MAH GYM left, MAH MATCH centre (fighting facility), MAH MARKET right; MAHPLAZA marker; corridors; quiet towers and mountains. Yellow light and concept icons deliberately not carried (brief §03, §07).

gates.name: Brightness / glare — readable without bloom-like wash
gates.note: energy emissive, additive opacity, entrance lights, plaza reflection and sun halo lowered; v3-*-standard vs v3-*-diagnostic (additive off, emissive ≤ 1, exposure fixed 1.0) shows the scene stays readable without glow. Day remains a cool steel-blue day by art direction.

gates.name: Species — one continuous teardrop lower body on EVERY resident, incl. interiors and reflections
gates.note: 18 residents (12 outdoor, 6 inside) all built by residents.js from the same teardrop lathe; no leg geometry exists (LAW-040). Audited in v3-residents-*, v3-gym-entrance-*, v3-match-entrance-*, v3-market-entrance-*, the practice frames and the mirrored reflections (same geometry).

gates.name: Appearance independence — world theme, local avatar and remote avatars are three owners; no global tint
gates.note: v3-check-1…5-wide.png at the SAME camera; capture.json.checks records each resident's own material emissive + vertex colours and read-back pixels; checkVerdicts: only the intended owner changes per step; canvas filter none; no overlay or override material.

gates.name: Detail without clutter — plants sparse, craft few, residents 8–12 outdoors, signage truthful
gates.note: leaf caps 4 / 5 / 7, three craft, 12 outdoor residents, one reserved mark slot per sign instead of pictograms, MAH MARKET name only.

gates.name: MAH MATCH — fighting facility with two honest functions
gates.note: copy MAH MATCH · MATCHES · PRACTICE; FIND AN OPPONENT selects to an honest unavailable state (no players, none simulated); PRACTICE WITH A BUDDY runs the local preview enter → positions → guard → strike → block → evade → reset → return with a clean exit (capture.json.practice.cleanExit) and an exercised early-exit path.

gates.name: Real camera — look / move, tap vs drag, reduced motion, teardown
gates.note: v3-camera-movement.webm: Tour, a 12-step pointer drag, wheel dolly, arrow keys; tap selects (≥ 8 px or ≥ 450 ms is a drag); prefers-reduced-motion makes moves instant and stops idle motion; dispose() removes every listener and geometry.

gates.name: Performance measured — draws / tris / ms, 15-minute idle / navigation / re-entry
gates.note: draw calls 158–513 and 15.5k–35.5k triangles per view (capture.json); ms/frame is software-GL only, not a phone number; soak.json holds the 15-minute run (heap, geometries, textures, programs) — see the summary; no real-device measurement exists in this environment.

performance: Measured on headless Chromium with ANGLE/SwiftShader (software GL). Draw calls and triangle counts are device-independent; frame times are not phone numbers. The 15-minute soak ran concurrently with the proof capture on the same machine, so its frame times are inflated further; its memory counters are the evidence.
